title: Squeeze along a filter by approximating families
statement: Let l be a filter on a type ι, m : ι → ℝ, a, b : ℕ → ι → ℝ, A, B : ℕ → ℝ and L ∈ ℝ. Suppose that for every k, eventually along l, a_k(i) ≤ m(i) ≤ b_k(i). Suppose also that a_k → A_k and b_k → B_k along l for every k, and that A_k → L and B_k → L as k → ∞. Then m → L along l.
lean_statement: ∀ {ι : Type} (l : Filter ι) (m : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (A B : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ k, ∀ᶠ i in l, a k i ≤ m i ∧ m i ≤ b k i) → (∀ k, Tendsto (a k) l (𝓝 (A k))) → (∀ k, Tendsto (b k) l (𝓝 (B k))) → Tendsto A atTop (𝓝 L) → Tendsto B atTop (𝓝 L) → Tendsto m l (𝓝 L)
